EX: No reasonable doubt that the last individual has died.
EW: Known only to survive in captivity or as a naturalized population well outside its historic range.
CR: The species is in imminent danger of extinction in the wild.
EN: The species is facing a very high risk of extinction in the wild.
VU: The species is facing a high risk of extinction in the wild.
NT: The species does not qualify as being at high risk of extinction but is likely to do so in the future.
LC: The species is not currently at risk of extinction in the wild.
DD: There is inadequate information to assess the risk of extinction for this species.
NE: The conservation status of the species has not been studied.
